name: song-selector
description: Google Sites Song Collection & Lyrics Export Application

scripts.test: node tests/test-backend.js && node tests/test-static-spa.js && node tests/test-google-oauth.js && node tests/test-mobile-hybrid.js
scripts.build: node scripts/download-songs.js && node scripts/build-auth-config.js && npx cap copy
scripts.build:aab: node scripts/build-auth-config.js && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.build:android: node scripts/build-auth-config.js && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease assembleRelease assembleDebug
scripts.build:ios: node scripts/build-auth-config.js && npx cap copy ios
scripts.deploy:pages: node scripts/build-auth-config.js && git push origin $(git subtree split --prefix public):refs/heads/gh-pages --force

author: Ravishankar Jayaraman
